question: What is the average first-innings score at M Chinnaswamy Stadium?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t), 2) FROM (SELECT match_id, SUM(total_runs) AS t FROM ball_facts WHERE inning = 1 AND venue ILIKE '%Chinnaswamy%' GROUP BY match_id) x
generated_sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(first_innings_total), 2) AS avg_first_innings_score
FROM (
    SELECT match_id, SUM(total_runs) AS first_innings_total
    FROM ball_facts
    WHERE inning = 1
      AND venue ILIKE '%M Chinnaswamy Stadium%'
    GROUP BY match_id
) AS t;
